12 is the latest approved patch-set.
No files were changed between the latest approved patch-set and the submitted one.

Now that this ia method, probably don't want to immediately exit?  Throw an exception maybe?

Not that important.

Thanks for looking into my patch!

Exceptions can be used if we manage any resources which need to be released or cleaned up, or if we can meaningfully recover form the error.

Is there anything we need to clean up here before exiting?

Otherwise i would like to exit quickly, since i do not see how we can recover from the error of not finding the schema file.

The point is really that methods shouldn't really be declaring exit for the entire application, and it removes all debug information about where the error happened from.

With that said, not worth holding up this patch.
There's 1 outstanding question.
